card.product: Discover it Cash Back Credit Card
card.product_version_note: Assumed variant: Discover it Cash Back (the it-card.html page names the product 'Discover it Cash Back Credit Card' and describes the 5% rotating-category program; it does not mention the Chrome, Miles, or Student variants, which have different earn structures). Discover's member-benefits page states that Discover Bank has merged into Capital One, N.A., and that some content may not apply to every card; Frequent Miler reports that some Discover it accounts have moved to Capital One servicing, where 5% activation is reached via the Capital One login (Rewards & Benefits > View Rewards). The personalized widget on cashback-calendar.html still fails to load, but on 2026-11-01 the page's static text and footnotes rendered, so the 2026 quarterly categories are verified on discover.com. Q1 2027 categories were not published as of 2026-11-01.

benefits.name: Cashback Match
benefits.period_note: Unlimited dollar-for-dollar match of all cash back earned from the day the new account is approved through the first 365 days; credited automatically within two billing periods after the match period ends
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Excludes rewards processed after the match period, statement credits, rewards transfers from Discover or Capital One deposit accounts, and rewards on closed accounts. New cardmembers only.

benefits.name: $200 bonus statement credit
benefits.period_note: Earn a $200 bonus statement credit when you spend $500 in the first 3 months
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: New cardmember welcome offer visible on the issuer product page; shown alongside Cashback Match

benefits.name: Q4 2026 5% Cashback Bonus categories: Restaurants, Entertainment, Utilities
benefits.period_note: 5% cash back on up to $1,500 in combined purchases in the quarter (maximum $75 cash back), then 1%; activation required and earning begins on the later of 10/1/26 or the activation date
benefits.enrollment_note: Activate via the Discover cashback calendar or Discover app. Discover says cards managed through Capital One should check there; the Capital One menu path (Rewards & Benefits > View Rewards) is per Frequent Miler only and unverified.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Restaurants: full-service restaurants, cafes, cafeterias, fast-food locations, caterers; restaurants inside hotels or retail stores and bakeries may not qualify. Entertainment: movie theaters, sports/theatrical/concert promoters, amusement parks, tourist attractions, aquariums, zoos, dance halls, record stores, video rental, pool halls, bowling alleys; excludes golf courses, country clubs, some collegiate sporting events, charitable events, cable and digital streaming and subscription services, amusement park tickets bought on third-party sites, and entertainment or resort packages categorized as travel or hotel. Utilities: residential electricity, natural gas, water, and phone or online purchases of internet, cable, satellite TV, and mobile or landline phone service; purchases at physical retail stores do not qualify; purchases through a landlord, property manager or HOA, home fuel delivery, standalone streaming, some satellite phone and internet service, and vehicle connectivity, accessories or equipment may not qualify. Merchant must be in the U.S. and qualification depends on merchant category code; some third-party payment and digital wallet transactions may not earn 5%.
benefits.verification_note: Categories, dates, cap and exclusions read in the static text and footnotes of the discover.com calendar page on 2026-11-01. The personalized calendar widget on that page still fails to load.
benefits.change_note: Verification upgrade observed 2026-11-01; categories, dates and cap unchanged. Old: verified false, sourced from NerdWallet, Doctor of Credit and AwardWallet. New: verified true on discover.com, with the issuer exclusions added.

benefits.name: $0 Fraud Liability
benefits.period_note: Cardmember is never responsible for unauthorized purchases on the Discover Card account, subject to investigation
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: An unauthorized purchase is one where the cardmember did not give card information to someone else for a charge

benefits.name: Freeze it (card lock)
benefits.period_note: Freeze the account in seconds with an on/off switch in the app or website; blocks new purchases, cash advances and balance transfers (including checks), while recurring merchant charges, returns, credits, dispute adjustments, payments, fees, interest, rewards redemptions and certain other exempted transactions may continue
benefits.verification_note: Read on discover.com 2026-11-01; the it-card.html page describes the same feature as 'Lock your card in the mobile app'
benefits.change_note: Correction observed 2026-11-01, not a confirmed issuer change. Old: blocks new purchases and cash advances. New: also blocks balance transfers; the list of activity that may continue is longer.

benefits.name: Free FICO Credit Score
benefits.period_note: Free FICO Credit Score plus score details, based on TransUnion data, for primary account holders; the it-card.html page frames this as a FICO Score 8 via CreditWise. Discover notes the benefit may change or end in the future.

benefits.name: Social Security Number alerts
benefits.period_note: Alert if the cardmember's Social Security Number is found on the dark web; free, online-only monitoring of the Experian credit report and dark web for primary cardmembers who opt in. Discover notes the benefit may change or end in the future.
